research_contract.question: Can an Origin-local prequential model choice retain difficulty Markov gains when regime dynamics are predictive and fall back to a stationary difficulty model otherwise?
research_contract.motivation: The fixed difficulty Markov beats 97.78% of random Selections and passes its temporal null, but helps only three of seven repositories and harms all three deep repositories.
non_solutions: choosing a history-length or forecast-distance threshold from observed future losses
training a learned gate from the sparse cross-repository Origin labels
searching priors, state bins, horizons, budgets, or scoring windows
using future states or held-out Agent outcomes in model choice
opening the sealed Agent holdout before every gate passes

shared_contract.task_difficulty_states: Reuse the frozen five equal-width reference-Agent solve-rate states.
shared_contract.rolling_origin: Reuse 15 minimum history Tasks, five future Tasks, ten selected Tasks, and repository-local Selection.
shared_contract.calendar_availability: Reuse the strict cross-repository created_at cutoff at the final target-history Task.
shared_contract.markov: Reuse the five-state repository-equal transition prior, symmetric total mass one per row, local prior strength five, and five-step forecast.
shared_contract.history_match_control: Reuse the exact previously frozen three-Agent history_match memberships.

fixed_algorithms.forecast: posterior categorical state distribution over the complete local history

fixed_algorithms.model_choice: Score Markov and stationary one-step predictive probabilities over every local history transition. Choose the lower mean negative log likelihood; exact ties choose stationary.
fixed_algorithms.markov_prequential_rule: Start local transition counts at zero with the frozen cutoff-aware global transition matrix as prior strength five; predict each next state before updating its transition count.
fixed_algorithms.stationary_prequential_rule: Start with symmetric categorical cell mass 0.2; predict each next state from all preceding local states before updating the state count.
fixed_algorithms.forecast_after_choice: Use the frozen five-step Markov forecast when Markov wins; otherwise use the stationary posterior distribution for every future step.
fixed_algorithms.selection: Reuse exact ten-Task state-histogram matching and within-state recency.

temporal_null.rule: shuffle complete eleven-Agent response vectors within repository and rematerialize model choice, forecasts, and Selections

agent_transfer.rule: For each development Agent, construct states, choose a model, forecast, and select with the other ten Agents; evaluate only the omitted Agent.

required_outputs: primary wide and deep repository summaries
model-choice counts by repository and Origin depth
selection, source, plan, and result digests

holdout_open_gate.priority: All requirements must hold; strict below boundaries fail on equality.

current_pool_stop_rule: If the adaptive candidate fails, do not invent another gate on these opened outcomes. Preserve the six-Agent holdout and require either a mechanism derived independently of these results or more calendar-eligible repository-local Origins.
